basic_details.job_title: PAU Project Associate Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Two Project Associate posts in an adhoc cotton project (sponsored by Ankur Seeds Pvt Ltd) at the Punjab Agricultural University Regional Research Station, Faridkot are to be filled on contract, initially for six months or till the project ends, whichever is earlier. Pay is Rs. 31,000 p.m fixed plus 10% HRA. The essential qualification is a B.Sc. in a listed subject and a Master degree in an Agriculture science subject or Life sciences, with NET. Applications on the prescribed form must reach the Director's office, Faridkot, by 25 November 2026 up to 4:30 p.m., and the interview is on 30 Novemb

how_to_apply: Get the prescribed application form from the office of the Director, PAU Regional Research Station, Faridkot.
Deposit a bank draft of Rs.200 in favour of The Comptroller, PAU payable at Faridkot.

Submit the application in the prescribed form with self attested copies of the certificates to the office of the Director, P.A.U. Regional Research Station, Circular Road, Faridkot, on or before 25.11.2026 (up to 4:30 p.m.).
Self attested copies of certificates, with the application.
Original copies of the testimonials, to be brought at the time of interview.
important_instructions: Applications go to the Director's office at Faridkot; the notice names no online or email route. The services of the incumbent are liable to be terminated at any time without any prior notice. Bring the original copies of the testimonials to the interview.

rows.details: Punjab Agricultural University (Regional Research Station, Faridkot)

Confined field BRL-I 1st year in north cotton growing zone of GE cotton harbouring Event NBRI-PGK-519 expressing modified mCry1EC and stacked with Events MON15985 Cry1Ac and Cry2Ab genes for resistance against cotton bollworms during Kharif 2026, Misc-126 (PC-8029)
Ankur Seeds Pvt Ltd (sponsor, as printed in the project title)
Initially six months or till termination of the project, whichever is earlier
Offline (prescribed form submitted at the office of the Director)

content_sections.heading: About PAU
content_sections.text: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) is based in Ludhiana, Punjab. This notice is issued by the Director of its Regional Research Station, Faridkot, for posts in an adhoc project at that station.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice prints one qualification list for the Project Associate post: B.Sc. (Life Sciences)/ B.Sc. Agri./ B.Sc. Biotech/ B.Sc. Hort./ B.Sc. Forestry, with minimum OCPA 6.00/10.00 basis or 60%. Master degree in any Agriculture science subject / Life sciences with minimum marks OGPA of 3.40/4.00 or OCPA 6.50/10.00 or 65% marks. Research experience in Entomology reflected through research publications/ Masters research. Knowledge of Punjabi up to Matric level. ASRB/UGC/CSIR NET in the relevant subject. For Ph.D in the relevant subject, NET will be exempted. Preference will be given to a candidate having higher educational qualification and research experience in Entomology. Candidates should check the official notification for any discipline-specific eligibility.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post is on contract basis in an adhoc project, initially for six months or till termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The services of the incumbent are liable to be terminated at any time without any prior notice.

content_sections.heading: PAU Project Associate Job Description
content_sections.text: To conduct laboratory and field research work as per objectives of the project. Any other duty that may be assigned from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for PAU Project Associate
content_sections.text: Get the prescribed application form from the office of the Director, PAU Regional Research Station, Faridkot. Deposit a bank draft of Rs.200 in favour of The Comptroller, PAU payable at Faridkot. Submit the application in the prescribed form with self attested copies of the certificates to the office of the Director, P.A.U. Regional Research Station, Circular Road, Faridkot, on or before 25.11.2026 (up to 4:30 p.m.). Self attested copies of certificates, with the application. Original copies of the testimonials, to be brought at the time of interview. Bank draft of Rs.200.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Interested candidates should appear before the selection committee for interview on 30.11.2026 at 11.00 AM in the office of the Director, Regional Research Station, Faridkot. No separate letter for interview will be issued. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications go to the Director's office at Faridkot; the notice names no online or email route. The services of the incumbent are liable to be terminated at any time without any prior notice. Bring the original copies of the testimonials to the interview.

rows.details: PAU notice for Project Associate, RRS Faridkot

faq.question: Q1. How many Project Associate posts are vacant at PAU Faridkot?
faq.answer: The notice announces two posts of Project Associate in an adhoc project at the Regional Research Station, Faridkot, to be filled on contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for PAU Project Associate?
faq.answer: Applications must be received on or before 25 November 2026, up to 4:30 p.m., at the office of the Director, Regional Research Station, Faridkot.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for PAU Project Associate?
faq.answer: A B.Sc. in Life Sciences, Agri., Biotech, Hort. or Forestry and a Master degree in an Agriculture science subject or Life sciences, with the marks printed in the notice. NET in the relevant subject is also listed, exempted for a Ph.D in the relevant subject.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of a PAU Project Associate?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 31,000/- p.m fixed plus 10 % HRA. Candidates without NET will be paid Rs 25000 plus 10 % HRA.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice states 10 % HRA along with both the Rs. 31,000 and the Rs 25000 pay.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.200, paid by bank draft in favour of The Comptroller, PAU payable at Faridkot.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the PAU Project Associate post?
faq.answer: Take the prescribed form from the Director's office at Regional Research Station, Faridkot, and submit it there with self attested copies of certificates and the bank draft by 25 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates appear before the selection committee for interview on 30 November 2026 at 11.00 AM at the Director's office, Faridkot, with original testimonials.

faq.question: Q9. Is the PAU Project Associate job permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is a contract post, initially for six months or till the project ends, whichever is earlier, and may be terminated at any time without prior notice.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice says no TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview, and no separate interview letter will be issued.
